theorems.name: Submission.frt_tangent_plane_unique
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (x : Euclidean N) (T T' : Grassmannian N n) (θ θ' : ℝ), HasTangentPlane V x T θ → HasTangentPlane V x T' θ' → T' = T ∧ θ' = θ
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
